# GNK ASG — Internal Dashboard Wireframe

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Goal

Create one internal view that shows what is ready, what is blocked, what is public and what needs human action.

## Main sections

### 1. System mode

- locked preparation
- review ready
- public ready
- active

### 2. Latest content package

- article title
- category
- image status
- metadata status
- canonical URL
- review status

### 3. Visual assets

- portal preview image
- square image
- video thumbnail
- alt text

### 4. Weekly video package

- working title
- script status
- thumbnail status
- description status
- release mode

### 5. Mail and scheduling assistant

- mode
- last checked item
- draft-only status
- next action

### 6. Public distribution drafts

- short public post
- business post
- video description
- release status

### 7. Technical health

- last deployment
- last validation
- broken links
- missing images
- metadata issues

### 8. Next human action

Show only one clear next action, for example:

- Review first article
- Confirm channel name
- Confirm contact mailbox
- Approve mobile menu
- Activate Insights archive

## Design rule

The dashboard is internal. It should be clear, compact and mobile friendly, but not linked from public navigation.
